question_plain: Please export the register of entities and their ownership, as of 31 October 2026.
question_original: The entity roster for S1 rests on a register held only in a system; no held document lists all entities and owners.
why_it_matters: Each committed entity needs its own standing; the roster decides which entities the design covers.
blocks: Design Brief section 1 (entity roster); gate T1
effect_of_answer: Decides which entities are committed and which are context.

if_unanswered.cost: The roster rests on the held articles only; entities they do not name stay unknown.

minimality_proof.why_unanswered: The articles name the parent only, not its subsidiaries or their owners.

suggested_seat.role_as_named: the company secretary, as the articles name the role
